blocks.title: Sexual Tension / Adult Contact Progression
blocks.body: E11 L157 freeze resolves only into embarrassment and Aunty's childcare interruption (P1), followed by Tuesday solitary guilt and conflicted private reflection. At pre-competition tuition the twins study earnestly before massage begins (P2–P3). Bantu starts massage despite Dhika's repeated 'no'; Bobby participates and raises it toward knee without checking. P4 distinguishes Bobby's initial accidental foot-slip from Dhika's later one deliberate movement and Bantu's subsequent knowledge. In P5 Bantu stages a second apparently accidental slip, the pair moves to high-thigh massage and Dhika refuses T-shirt removal twice. P6 she independently removes her T-shirt, but Bantu without asking touches her bra/breast area and tastes a milk drop, provoking her startled recoil. P7–P8 register his apologies, her limited/playful plus genuine anger, Bobby's request and Dhika's explicit refusal of milk to either twin.

blocks.title: Reader-Known Secrets & Dramatic Irony
blocks.body: Only Dhika knows the full guilt/confusion she carries from the Monday Chotu encounter; Chotu heard her moan but did not receive an explanation. At Tuesday tuition, Bantu and Bobby each bring a distinct previous intimate memory. During massage, Dhika knows she has noticed Bobby's foot accident while he hopes she has not; Bantu initially does not understand, later notices her movement and privately plans the staged second contact. Dhika is not shown knowing Bantu's staging. Dhika's voluntary clothing removal is not a transfer of permission to touch breast or taste milk. At the end Dhika internally rejects sharing milk with Bobby and blames herself, while Bobby remains upset without hearing all her reasoning.

blocks.title: Major Turning Points & Why They Matter
blocks.body: P1 ends E11's open encounter without explaining the moan to Chotu and begins Dhika's private Tuesday conflict. P2 establishes a real, nearly complete academic workload, Friday test and Saturday competition. P3 creates a boundary conflict at massage initiation despite its later relief. P4 turns accidental Bobby foot placement into divergent private knowledge and Bantu's deliberate plan. P5 contrasts staged Bantu foot contact with uncertain Bobby thigh intent and records two clothing refusals. P6 separates Dhika's own T-shirt removal from Bantu's unauthorized bra touch/milk tasting. P7 makes his apology and Bobby's comparative request explicit. P8 ends with her denial to both and unresolved guilt plus Bobby disappointment.

blocks.title: Open Hooks / Unresolved Questions
blocks.body: Dhika has not resolved what Monday's Chotu experience means for her own values and marriage, nor explained the moan to him. Twins' Friday test and Saturday competition remain upcoming, not completed. The longer-term boundary consequences of Bantu's uninvited breast contact have not been discussed beyond immediate criticism and apology. Bobby is still unhappy after she refuses milk, while Dhika privately blames herself; the story stops before any future response. E12 L135 speaker tag may be a RAW attribution anomaly and is flagged, not silently repaired.

blocks.title: Reader Possibilities — NON-CANON
blocks.body: Future reconciliation, formal boundary conversation, confession to John, competition results or Bobby's next response would be speculative. Nothing in E12 confirms a second milk sample or Bobby tasting milk. Dhika's guilt and her refusal to share milk with either twin are factual present states; imagined future exceptions are NOT CANON. Do not use E13 to close E12 hooks while writing E12.

blocks.title: Episode-End Reader Carry-Forward
blocks.body: Hard stop E12 L153: Bobby remains sad and has not tasted milk. Bantu tasted exactly one drop from Dhika's wet bra without prior consent, apologized and requested another, which Dhika denied. Dhika explicitly says her milk is neither boy's to drink, internally considers sharing it with Bobby a major boundary crossing and ends privately blaming herself. Twins' Friday test/Saturday competition remain future. No E13 action belongs to this episode.
